description: Search Google News for one or more keywords and get articles with the real publisher URL, source, publication date, description and optionally the full article text. Supports a recent timeframe or a custom date range, any country and language, and more than 100 articles per keyword. Google operators work in keywords ("exact phrase", site:reuters.com, -word).

full_text.description: Include the full article text (longer answer)

max_articles.description: Max articles per keyword. Above 100 the search is split by date

region.description: Country:language, e.g. US:en, GB:en, IN:en, FR:fr, DE:de, ES:es, BR:pt-419, JP:ja (84 pairs)

timeframe.description: Recent period. Ignored if date_from or date_to is set

name: search_news
title: Google News: search articles
